network_status.summary_it: Anche per il secondo attraversamento di Sanfront il rapporto non pubblica una sezione idrometrica locale. Le portate del Po misurate dopo l'apporto dei bacini di valle non sono rappresentative del punto selezionato.
network_status.summary_en: For the second Sanfront crossing the report likewise publishes no local gauge section. Po discharges measured after downstream tributary contributions are not representative of the selected point.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
